protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias, not fixed weights or verified training cutoff
protocol.aggregation: Each month/repeat separately, equal cell average; Q9 headline-style center is median of individually fitted density means, not a nationwide headline.
protocol.intervals: 2000 paired-person resamples within month, both generations together; 4-month resampling sensitivity; seed 20261015
protocol.sampling: Uniform seeded subsample of the existing frozen 48-person roster; no target answers used.
protocol.comparison: Same P/E, actual previous Q8/Q9 and earlier summaries, questionnaire and shared state instruction; response representation only differs.
protocol.primary_contrast: revision minus direct on cross-section W1
protocol.candidate_gate: Primary W1 paired-person upper 95% bound < 0; center MAE and delta W1 points no worse; new scorable fraction >=99%. Pilot continuation only, not overall success.
protocol.missing_previous_Q8: Report absolute point_pct for that respondent, still revise Q9; no imputation from Q9 mean, no exclusion.
protocol.neutral_question: No required adjustment size/direction, no fixed inertia parameter or forced dispersion.
protocol.no_information_change: Common context including prior and forecast window verified for every pair. Two repeated generations measure same-message variation; not a behavioural no-news causal test.
protocol.support: Common truth/prior/scorable support for both arms and past baselines; failures counted explicitly, never replaced or normalized.
protocol.truth_isolation: Only existing roster/preview/P/E read in preparation; current Q8/Q9 enter evaluation only.
limits: All four months are previously inspected development periods; no independent validation claim.
Conditional returner A using real past answers; not recursive B or a national headline.
Uniform subsample of an earlier selected roster, not a fresh nationally representative population.
Old 2020Q4 synthetic CE shares are retrospective for 2020-04; this is an A diagnostic, not strict real-time B.
Delta-format arithmetic may fail or alter anchoring. Invalid mass is rejected, never clipped/normalized.
Model alias may change; returned IDs/fingerprints are recorded but do not verify training cutoff.
Engine seeds do not fix API random draws; old batches are descriptive background only.
Modified response format is not the unmodified official survey interface.

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

interval_scope: No accuracy inference: arm-dependent invalidity exceeds the prespecified validity gate. Complete-row descriptions are selection-affected, not all-sample effects.
analysis_amendment_after_validity_failur: Initial bootstrap stopped on zero supported mass in a resample. No prompts or answers were changed; no new API. Report primary validity failure and descriptive common-row values only, rather than inventing a conditional bootstrap.
